summary.text: Danielle Lammon is the Republican candidate for Colorado State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
She is a small business owner who, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses, has served on citizen budget committees and nonprofit boards.

paragraphs.text: In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Danielle Lammon listed three campaign messages: affordability and economic stability for families, support for small businesses and local economies, and transparent, fiscally responsible government.
The survey responses say she supports protecting TABOR and drawing on her nonprofit and foundation leadership experience to promote workforce development and job creation.
She also said she is passionate about public safety, education and early childhood literacy.
